scientific_integrity: Analytic backward-equation proof and constrained optimization; independently structured exact-rational backward-equation checker and 1440 deterministic comparisons. Originality is provisional relative to unindexed or inaccessible prior research; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact for one-dimensional finite-speed run-and-tumble motion with identical positive sticky-wall release rates, Poisson heading reversals, and fixed sum of wall-killing rates. No claim for arbitrary residence laws, biased heading launches or a general Brownian/large-budget uniform limit.
title: Optimal allocation of two sticky reactive walls: a finite-speed allocation law
